description: This file appears to be a shell script containing a comprehensive set of git merge tests focusing on various cases such as no renames, basic renames, directory renames, and handling of dirty changes. It defines functions to set up specific repository states and expects certain merge behaviors to be verified using test assertions.

methods.name: test_setup_1a
methods.description: Initializes a git repo for testcase 1a involving no renames, with specific changes on commits A and B.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful merge behavior for the setup.

methods.name: test_setup_2a
methods.description: Initializes a git repo for testcase 2a involving renames with specific changes and expected merge outcomes.

methods.name: test_setup_2b
methods.description: Sets up repo for testcase 2b involving change and rename on A and B, verifying merge correctness.

methods.name: test_setup_2c
methods.description: Prepares repo for a complex rename and modification scenario involving conflicts.

methods.name: test_setup_3a
methods.description: Sets up directory rename cases where a file is moved into a directory and that directory is renamed.

methods.name: test_setup_3b
methods.description: Prepares repository for directory rename with concurrent changes on both sides.

methods.name: test_setup_4a
methods.description: Involves a scenario with local modifications and subset changes from two commits to test merge behavior with dirty working directory.

methods.name: test_setup_4b
methods.description: Sets up repo for testing rename + modification with local changes, verifying correct merge handling.
